title: Running Route Loop Generator: Circular Routes
description: Generate a suggested walking or cycling loop from a chosen start. Routing and elevation depend on external services; check the result before use.
summary_sentence: Choose a start and a target between 1 and 30 miles; the generated loop may be substantially longer or shorter than the target.
quick_answer: The generator attempts a walking or cycling loop from your chosen start through four surrounding points, then reports the routed length and sampled elevation when available. If routing fails, it displays a straight-line fallback, not a usable road or path route.

faq: Will the loop be exactly my target distance?
It aims at it and reports the real distance of the loop it built — street geometry rarely permits the exact figure, and the honest report beats a rounded claim.
How is the loop built?
The tool routes from the selected start through four points placed around it and back to the start. It samples elevation when available. If routing fails, it shows a straight-line fallback.
Does the route include live traffic?
No. Loops are geometry and network; run them with a runner's own road sense at crossings.
Why is road distance longer than straight-line?
A routed loop follows the available network. If routing fails, the displayed fallback uses straight segments instead and should not be treated as a usable trail.
Can route results change over time?
New paths and better data change what loops are possible; regenerate in a new season and the town has quietly grown new runs.
Can I export the loop?
The Running Route Planner exports GPX for point-to-point routes; a generated loop can be re-created there as a route if your device needs the file.
Run or cycle — does it matter?
The chosen activity requests a walking or cycling route. If routing fails, the tool shows a straight-line fallback rather than a navigable path. Check access and conditions locally.
The loop crosses a river twice — intended?
Bridges are the network's gifts; the loop uses the crossings the map offers. Enjoy the out-and-back skyline.
Can I ask for a hillier loop?
There is no hilliness control or alternative generator. Sampled climb is shown when elevation data is available.
Loops for a pram or wheelchair?
The tool does not verify accessibility, pavement, gradients, crossings or barriers. Consult reliable local accessibility information before travel.
